publicly_readable: One article, reprinted on worldin.economist.com in 2015 for the 30th edition ("The World in 1989...and on to the 1990s", by Mary Goldring (editor of The World in 1989)), read from an Internet Archive snapshot.
not_readable: Everything else in the issue. No other text of this edition was found in public form.
notes: Edition number counted from The World in 1987 = 1. Publication month not confirmed; year only. The reprint is The Economist's own web copy of the original article. The reprinted article is about the 1990s as a decade, not 1989, and holds no testable prediction for 1989.
